elsewhere.note: So David would not move Yahweh’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also…
